from: The FIA Formula One Technical Delegate
incident_time: 09:05 2022 MEXICAN GRAND PRIX 27 - 30 October 2022 Technical Delegate's Report Last night team personnel of the Mercedes-AMG Petronas Formula One Team, who are associated with the operation of the car, were within the confines of the circuit during the ten and a half hours period which commenced at 22:30 on 28 October, thirteen and a half hours before the scheduled start time of P3 and ends three hours before the scheduled start time of P3 at 09:00 on 29 October. This was the second of the two individual exceptions permitted for the Mercedes-AMG Petronas Formula One Team during the 2022 Formula One Championship season and therefore no action should be taken. The FIA Formula One Technical Delegate Jo Bauer
title: Curfew
